newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at $109/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at $109/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers were steady near midday Thursday on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), with no sales reported on heifers. All sales were in the far western part of the state.
Dressed Basis Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 108.00- 109.00. Dressed Basis Heifers - None confirmed.
Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in western Nebraska, otherwise, market not established in the rest of the state. Buyer inquiry was strong and seller interest light.

Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Slaughter Steers - Few Select/Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 66.00. Slaughter Heifers- Few Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 66.00. Confirmed - 700 For the week - 11,300
